MeterSphere versions 1.13.0 before 1.14.7 and 1.15.0 before 1.16.4 contain a pre-authentication code injection vulnerability due to the /plugin/** endpoints being exposed with anonymous access. Attackers can upload a malicious jar via POST /plugin/add and invoke it through POST /plugin/customMethod using the 'entry' and 'request' parameters, which are passed to Class.forName and method invocation for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation o

CmsEasy 7.7.5_20210919 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the execsql_action function at /?case=crossall&act=execsql that executes attacker-supplied queries decrypted with the hardcoded key 'cmseasy_sql'. Attackers can send a crafted 'sql' parameter to run arbitrary SQL and dump the admin username and password hash. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-22.

Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.
tech: Synway Information Engineering Co., Ltd. Synway SMG Gateway Management Software

desc: QiboCMS V7 contains an arbitrary file download vulnerability in inc/job/download.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by supplying a base64-encoded url parameter to /do/job.php?job=download. tech: Tangshan Pingsheng Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. Reservoir Safety Supervision Platform

Successful exploitation allows an attacker to forge ViewState payloads for server-side deserialization, allowing for remote code execution.

title: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
desc: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.

title: CrushFTP Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
desc: CrushFTP contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the HTTP authorization header that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to authenticate to any known or guessable user account (e.g., crushadmin), potentially leading to a full compromise.

title: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
desc: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows for code execution when processing an audio stream in a maliciously crafted media file.

title: Apple Multiple Products Arbitrary Read and Write Vulnerability
desc: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain an arbitrary read and write vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass Pointer Authentication.

title: Apple Multiple Products Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Apple Safari, iOS, watchOS, visionOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow the processing of maliciously crafted web content which may lead to memory corruption.

title: SAP NetWeaver Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
desc: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated agent to upload potentially malicious executable binaries.

title: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

title: Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
desc: Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands without valid credentials, potentially leading to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). By exploiting a flaw in how SSH protocol messages are handled, a malicious actor could gain unauthorized access to affected systems. This vulnerability could affect various products that implement Erlang/OTP SSH server, including—but not limited

title: Sudo Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
desc: Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.

title: Langflow Missing Authentication Vulnerability
desc: Langflow contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v1/validate/code endpoint that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted HTTP requests.

title: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

title: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

title: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges to administrator.

title: Fortinet Multiple Products Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Fortinet FortiFone, FortiVoice, FortiNDR and FortiMail contain a stack-based overflow vulnerability that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

title: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) Improper Authentication Vulnerability
desc: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate users without valid credentials.

title: Microsoft Windows External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code from a remote WebDAV location specified by the WorkingDirectory attribute of Internet Shortcut files.

title: Microsoft Windows SMB Client Improper Access Control Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows SMB Client contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation. An attacker could execute a specially crafted malicious script to coerce the victim machine to connect back to the attack system using SMB and authenticate.

title: Versa Concerto Improper Authentication Vulnerability
desc: Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.

title: Commvault Command Center Path Traversal Vulnerability
desc: Commvault Command Center contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

title: Langflow Origin Validation Error Vulnerability
desc: Langflow contains an origin validation error vulnerability in which an overly permissive CORS configuration combined with a refresh token cookie configured as SameSite=None allows a malicious webpage to perform cross-origin requests that include credentials and successfully call the refresh endpoint. This could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and achieve full system compromise via obtained tokens that permit access to authenticated endpoints.

title: Craft CMS External Control of Assumed-Immutable Web Parameter Vulnerability
desc: Craft CMS contains an external control of assumed-immutable web parameter vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated client to introduce arbitrary values, such as PHP code, to a known local file location on the server. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2024-58136 as represented by CVE-2025-32432.

title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

title: Linux Kernel Time-of-Check Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
desc: Linux kernel contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

title: Commvault Web Server Unspecified Vulnerability
desc: Commvault Web Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to create and execute webshells.

title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Authentication Vulnerability
desc: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains an improper authentication vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow a ViewState code injection attack, which could allow remote code execution if machine keys are compromised.

title: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
desc: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

title: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
desc: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

title: Smartbedded Meteobridge Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: Smartbedded Meteobridge contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote unauthenticated attackers to gain arbitrary command execution with elevated privileges (root) on affected devices.

title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Security Control Bypass Vulnerability
desc: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a security control bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to certain restricted functionality.

title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
desc: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution, which would allow an attacker to run commands on the host machine. This could be exploited without authentication.

title: SonicWall SMA1000 Missing Authorization Vulnerability
desc: SonicWall SMA1000 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation appliance management console (AMC) of affected devices.

product: VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools
title: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools Privilege Defined with Unsafe Actions Vulnerability
desc: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools contain a privilege defined with unsafe actions vulnerability. A malicious local actor with non-administrative privileges having access to a VM with VMware Tools installed and managed by Aria Operations with SDMP enabled may exploit this vulnerability to escalate privileges to root on the same VM.

title: Qualitia Active! Mail Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Qualitia Active! Mail contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary or trigger a denial-of-service via a specially crafted request.

title: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
desc: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

ai.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal fails to properly neutralize special elements in its data query logic, letting an unauthenticated attacker inject JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookups. This can expose or alter server information, and it is known to be exploited.
ai.impact: information disclosure and modification
ai.action: Apply the vendor's SAP security patch for NetWeaver Enterprise Portal immediately, and restrict network access to the portal while patching is pending.

title: SAP NetWeaver Deserialization Vulnerability
desc: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a privileged attacker to compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the host system by deserializing untrusted or malicious content.

title: Apple Multiple Products Unspecified Vulnerability
desc: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS, contain an unspecified vulnerability when processing a maliciously crafted photo or video shared via an iCloud Link.

title: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
desc: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Image I/O framework.

title: Apple Multiple Products Improper Locking Vulnerability
desc: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain an improper locking vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected changes in memory shared between processes.

title: Apple Multiple Products Classic Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain a classic buffer overflow vulnerability which could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected system termination or write kernel memory.

title: Apple Multiple Products Use-After-Free WebKit Vulnerability
desc: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a use-after-free vulnerability in WebKit. Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
desc: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the API component that allows an attacker to access protected resources without proper credentials via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Spring Framework open-source library.

title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability in the API component that allows an authenticated attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Hibernate Validator open-source library, as represented by CVE-2025-35036.

title: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
desc: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to write arbitrary file as system authority.

title: TeleMessage TM SGNL Hidden Functionality Vulnerability
desc: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains a hidden functionality vulnerability in which the archiving backend holds cleartext copies of messages from TM SGNL application users.

title: Wing FTP Server Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character Vulnerability
desc: Wing FTP Server contains an improper neutralization of null byte or NUL character vulnerability that can allow injection of arbitrary Lua code into user session files. This can be used to execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the FTP service (root or SYSTEM by default).

title: Wing FTP Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
desc: Wing FTP Server contains a generation of error message containing sensitive information vulnerability when using a long value in the UID cookie.

title: IGEL OS Use of a Key Past its Expiration Date Vulnerability
desc: IGEL OS contains a use of a key past its expiration date vulnerability that allows for Secure Boot bypass. The igel-flash-driver module improperly verifies a cryptographic signature. Ultimately, a crafted root filesystem can be mounted from an unverified SquashFS image.

title: Git Link Following Vulnerability
desc: Git contains a link following vulnerability that stems from Git’s inconsistent handling of carriage return characters in configuration files.

title: Android Runtime Use-After-Free Vulnerability
desc: Android Runtime contains a use-after-free vulnerability potentially allowing a chrome sandbox escape leading to local privilege escalation.

title: Android Framework Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
desc: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

title: Android Framework Integer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Android Framework contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows for code execution that could allow for local privilege escalation.

title: Android Framework Information Disclosure Vulnerability
desc: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
desc: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript within the user's session, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via shell metacharacters in the t_total parameter in a filemanager changePerm request. A valid non-root username must be known.

title: TeleMessage TM SGNL Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default Vulnerability
desc: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an initialization of a resource with an insecure default vulnerability. This vulnerability relies on how the Spring Boot Actuator is configured with an exposed heap dump endpoint at a /heapdump URI.

title: TeleMessage TM SGNL Exposure of Core Dump File to an Unauthorized Control Sphere Vulnerability
desc: TeleMessage TM SGNL contains an exposure of core dump file to an unauthorized control sphere Vulnerability. This vulnerability is based on a JSP application in which the heap content is roughly equivalent to a "core dump" in which a password previously sent over HTTP would be included in this dump.

title: RoundCube Webmail Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
desc: RoundCube Webmail contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote code execution by authenticated users because the _from parameter in a URL is not validated in program/actions/settings/upload.php.

title: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49706. CVE-2025-53770 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49704, and the updates for CVE-2025-53770 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49704.

title: Microsoft SharePoint Improper Authentication Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft SharePoint contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network. Successfully exploitation could allow an attacker to view sensitive information and make some changes to disclosed information. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49704. CVE-2025-53771 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49706, and the updates for CVE-2025-53771 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49706.

title: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
desc: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could lead to a remote code execution.

title: SmarterTools SmarterMail Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
desc: SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to any location on the mail server, potentially enabling remote code execution.

title: F5 BIG-IP Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow a threat actor to achieve remote code execution.

title: Sitecore Multiple Products Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
desc: Sitecore Experience Manager (XM), Experience Platform (XP), Experience Commerce (XC), and Managed Cloud contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability involving the use of default machine keys. This flaw allows attackers to exploit exposed ASP.NET machine keys to achieve remote code execution.

title: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft SharePoint Server on-premises contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-53771. CVE-2025-53770 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49704, and the updates for CVE-2025-53770 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49704.

title: Laravel Livewire Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Laravel Livewire contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote command execution in specific scenarios.

title: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
desc: Google Chromium V8 contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
desc: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API.

title: Adobe Experience Manager Forms Code Execution Vulnerability
desc: Adobe Experience Manager Forms in JEE contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

title: CrushFTP Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
desc: CrushFTP contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability. When the DMZ proxy feature is not used, mishandles AS2 validation and consequently allows remote attackers to obtain admin access via HTTPS.

title: Prettier eslint-config-prettier Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
desc: Prettier eslint-config-prettier contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability. Installing an affected package executes an install.js file that launches the node-gyp.dll malware on Windows.

title: Trend Micro Apex One OS Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: Trend Micro Apex One Management Console (on-premise) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated remote attacker to upload malicious code and execute commands on affected installations.

title: Meta Platforms WhatsApp Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
desc: Meta Platforms WhatsApp contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability due to an incomplete authorization of linked device synchronization messages. This vulnerability could allow an unrelated user to trigger processing of content from an arbitrary URL on a target’s device.

title: Meta React Server Components Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
desc: Meta React Server Components contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution by exploiting a flaw in how React decodes payloads sent to React Server Function endpoints. Please note CVE-2025-66478 has been rejected, but it is associated with CVE-2025- 55182.

title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
desc: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability due to insufficient input validation. This vulnerability can lead to memory overread when the NetScaler is configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

title: Sangoma FreePBX Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
desc: Sangoma FreePBX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficiently sanitized user-supplied data allows unauthenticated access to FreePBX Administrator leading to arbitrary database manipulation and remote code execution.

title: Fortinet FortiWeb OS Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: Fortinet FortiWeb contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code on the underlying system via crafted HTTP requests or CLI commands.

title: OSGeo GeoServer Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
desc: OSGeo GeoServer contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that occurs when the application accepts XML input through a specific endpoint /geoserver/wms operation GetMap and could allow an attacker to define external entities within the XML request.

title: Microsoft Windows Improper Access Control Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows contains an improper access control vulnerability in Windows Remote Access Connection Manager which could allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

title: Microsoft Windows Server Update Service (WSUS) Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows Server Update Service (WSUS) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

title: ASUS Live Update Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
desc: ASUS Live Update contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability client were distributed with unauthorized modifications introduced through a supply chain compromise. The modified builds could cause devices meeting specific targeting conditions to perform unintended actions. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

title: Libraesva Email Security Gateway Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: Libraesva Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains a command injection vulnerability which allows command injection via a compressed e-mail attachment.

title: Fortinet Multiple Products Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature Vulnerability
desc: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchMaster, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass the FortiCloud SSO login authentication via a crafted SAML message. Please be aware that CVE-2025-59719 pertains to the same problem and is mentioned in the same vendor advisory. Ensure to apply all patches mentioned in the advisory.

title: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows contains a link following vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation

title: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
desc: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

title: Oracle Fusion Middleware Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
desc: Oracle Fusion Middleware contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to take over Identity Manager.

title: Oracle E-Business Suite Unspecified Vulnerability
desc: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an unspecified vulnerability in the BI Publisher Integration component. The vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Concurrent Processing. Successful attacks can result in takeover of Oracle Concurrent Processing.

title: Oracle E-Business Suite Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
desc: Oracle E-Business Suite contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Runtime component of Oracle Configurator. This vulnerability is remotely exploitable without authentication.

title: Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager Improper Verification of Source of a Communication Channel Vulnerability
desc: Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager contains an improper verification of source of a communication channel vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending specially crafted packets.
Improper input validation within the AmdPlatformRasSmm driver could allow an attacker with privileged access to overwrite SMRAM, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution.

desc: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

desc: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain privileged access to the application.

title: RARLAB WinRAR Path Traversal Vulnerability
desc: RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute code in the context of the current user.

title: Microsoft Windows Race Condition Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability that allows a local attacker with low-level privileges to escalate privileges. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could enable the attacker to gain SYSTEM-level access.

title: Microsoft Windows Use After Free Vulnerability
desc: Microsoft Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver contains a use after free vulnerability that can allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

title: Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

title: Sangoma FreePBX OS Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: Sangoma FreePBX Endpoint Manager contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow for a post-authentication command injection by an authenticated known user via the testconnection -> check_ssh_connect() function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to potentially obtain remote access to the system as an asterisk user.

The ownCloud Desktop Client synchronizes files between an ownCloud server and a desktop. Prior to 6.0.2, an authenticated attacker can share a specially crafted file with a victim. If the file is synced by the client and revealed in the macOS Finder, it can cause operating-system command injection on the victim’s computer. This issue is fixed in version 6.0.2.

title: Fortinet FortiWeb Path Traversal Vulnerability
desc: Fortinet FortiWeb contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute administrative commands on the system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability leading to unintended control flow and Denial of Service. NetScaler must be configured as Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
desc: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform arbitrary read/write via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

title: Google Chromium ANGLE and GPU Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
desc: Google Chromium contains an improper input validation vulnerability in ANGLE and GPU. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
desc: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Classic UI where attackers could abuse Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) @import directives in email HTML.

title: Array Networks ArrayOS AG OS Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: Array Networks ArrayOS AG contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

title: Lantronix EDS5000 Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Lantronix EDS5000 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands into the username parameter. Injected commands are executed with root privileges.

title: RoundCube Webmail Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
desc: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document.

title: n8n Improper Control of Dynamically-Managed Code Resources Vulnerability
desc: n8n contains an improper control of dynamically managed code resources vulnerability in its workflow expression evaluation system that allows for remote code execution.

title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) PHP Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
desc: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a PHP remote file inclusion vulnerability that could allow for remote attackers to craft requests to the /h/rest endpoint to influence internal request dispatching, allowing inclusion of arbitrary files from the WebRoot directory.

title: Fortinet FortiOS Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
desc: Fortinet FortiOS contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability. This may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass the patch developed for the symbolic link persistency mechanism observed in some post-exploit cases, via crafted HTTP requests. An attacker would need first to have compromised the product via another vulnerability, at filesystem level.

vtenext 25.02 before 25.02.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to change any account password via hub/rpwd.php without token verification. Attackers knowing a valid user_name can send action=change_password to RecoverPwd::displayChangePwd() and log in as administrators lacking two-factor authentication.

title: Citrix NetScaler Memory Overflow Vulnerability
desc: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a memory overflow vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution and/or denial of service.

title: RARLAB WinRAR Path Traversal Vulnerability
desc: RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting the Windows version of WinRAR. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious archive files.

title: Gogs Path Traversal Vulnerability
desc: Gogs contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting improper Symbolic link handling in the PutContents API that could allow for code execution.

title: N-able N-Central Insecure Deserialization Vulnerability
desc: N-able N-Central contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that could lead to command execution.

title: N-able N-Central Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: N-able N-Central contains a command injection vulnerability via improper sanitization of user input.

title: WatchGuard Firebox Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
desc: WatchGuard Firebox contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

title: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
desc: TP-Link Archer C7(EU) and TL-WR841N/ND(MS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that exists in the Parental Control page. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
desc: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
desc: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the User-ID Authentication Portal (aka Captive Portal) service that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls by sending specially crafted packets.

title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
desc: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

ai.summary: Rucio's validate_auth_token function does not distinguish short-lived SSH challenge nonces from real authentication tokens stored in the same table. Arista C-260 and C-250 access points ship with fleet-wide static cryptographic keys used for firmware image verification and SSLP authentication. An attacker who is able to access these keys would be able to create modified firmware that will pass verification checks. This vulnerability is specific to the C-260 and C-250 models; other access point models enforce digitally signed upgrade images with secure boot and are not affected by this issue.

Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.6.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS reads Git configuration options defined for a submodule without checking certain values for embedded line-ending control characters. A malicious repository can insert control characters such as line feed (LF) into those values to mimic options that cause Git LFS to execute an attacker-controlled command or binary while fetching or adding objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 1.3.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS does not correctly filter the limited set of options permitted in a repository's .lfsconfig file when option keys contain certain additional components. Crafted keys can mimic options that configure Git LFS to use a custom command to transfer objects, causing Git LFS to execute an attacker-selected command or binary while fetching objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

desc: The JDBC based JAAS login module accepts a login without a password for accounts whose stored password is NULL. A remote attacker who knows the user name of such an account can authenticate as that user and obtain its roles. Only deployments using this login module with NULL passwords in the user table are affected. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

A negative MicroProfile JWT clock skew setting is not rejected and disables validation of the token expiration and other time-based claims. In such configurations, an attacker in possession of an expired token can still authenticate with it. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

When MicroProfile JWT role-based access control is used, the access constraints of JAX-RS resources are not always enforced as declared: resources that declare an empty set of allowed roles are accessible to every caller, resource classes that inherit the same method from a common superclass share their constraints, and class-level constraints declared on a superclass are ignored. A remote attacker can invoke resources that should be denied to them, in some configurations without authentication.

After a successful WS-Security UsernameToken authentication, the caller identity stays associated with the worker thread once the request completes when web services are served by the standalone OpenEJB HTTP server. A remote unauthenticated attacker whose request is later processed on the same thread can invoke protected EJB methods with the identity of a previously authenticated user. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The development-time LiveReload support listens on all network interfaces without authentication and accepts websocket connections from any origin. A network attacker, or a web page visited by the developer, can observe the names of changed files in the watched folder and the server version, and reach the deployed applications through the additional port. The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server reports every request as authenticated when an application requests authentication programmatically. A remote unauthenticated attacker can access functionality protected this way. Only applications served by the embedded HTTP server that rely on programmatic authentication are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

When JAX-WS or JAX-RS endpoints are published by the embedded OpenEJB HTTP server rather than Tomcat, some configured authentication methods are silently ignored and the endpoint is published without authentication. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed operations without credentials. Only deployments that use the embedded HTTP server and rely on such an authentication method are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted

The embedded server generates HTTP session identifiers with a non-cryptographic random number generator by default. A remote attacker who observes a session identifier can predict the identifiers issued to other users and hijack their sessions, if the application relies on HTTP sessions for authentication. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The Jakarta Security OpenID Connect authentication mechanism generates the state and nonce values with a non-cryptographic random number generator and insufficient entropy. A remote attacker who predicts these values can forge an authentication callback that logs a victim into the attacker's account, and the replay protection for ID tokens is weakened. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The Jakarta Security LDAP identity store accepts an empty password as valid if the directory server allows unauthenticated binds, which some directory servers do by default. A remote attacker can then authenticate as any existing user without knowing the password. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The security constraint generated for EJB JAX-WS endpoints with configured authentication protects only some HTTP methods. A remote unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication by sending requests with another HTTP method. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

Under specific conditions, successful exploitation may allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the system with the privileges of an affected user. When a server sends no Certificate message and a ServerKeyExchange without a signature, ssl_handshake:decode_server_key/3 reports the signature algorithm as anon, and ssl_handshake:verify_signature/5 returns true for anon without a public key. Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Alejandro Alex Reservations alex-reservations allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Alex Reservations: from n/a through 2.4.8.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous GraphQL clients to read out-of-scope section entries via prev/next fields. Attackers can chain next hops from one visible in-scope entry to enumerate entries and read titles, slugs, and custom-field content from withheld sections.

Scriban before 7.5.2 contains an information disclosure and object manipulation vulnerability that allows template authors to access .NET internals of function values through reflection member accessors. Attackers can use array.map to read Target, Method, or ReturnType on imported delegates, exposing and overwriting service properties, captured closure secrets, and assembly paths.

Kyverno from 1.19.1 before 1.19.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the apiCall namespace clamp that allows namespace tenants to issue cross-namespace and cluster-scoped API requests by appending malformed percent-escapes to urlPath. Attackers can create namespaced Policies whose apiCall runs as the admission-controller ServiceAccount to read other namespaces' resources and create mutating webhooks, escalating to cluster admin.

OpenEMR from 7.0.1 before 8.4.0 contains a flaw in src/Common/Auth/OneTimeAuth.php that ignores the enforce_onetime_use and max_access_count flags, never revokes consumed service_auth tokens, and checks login_pin without rate limiting or strict comparison. Attackers holding a captured token can replay it or brute-force the PIN to open patient-portal sessions exposing PHI.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken access control and path traversal vulnerability in the fax/sms module disposeDocument action via an unvalidated file_path parameter. Authenticated low-privilege users can read sqlconf.php to recover database credentials and write arbitrary files as the web user, enabling remote code execution.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with CAMOS access to inject HTML by saving malicious CAMOS content through ajax_save.php. Attackers can store a script payload that executes unencoded when the entry is printed via the non-print_html branch of rx_print.php, performing actions and reading data as the victim user.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Fee Sheet drug-inventory lookup (DrugSalesService::sellDrug) that interpolates the prod[N][warehouse] POST field into an ORDER BY clause. Low-privileged authenticated users can submit Fee Sheet product lines with constant subqueries to run a time-based blind oracle, extracting patient data and users_secure bcrypt hashes.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the RingCentral RCFaxClient disposeDocument() method of oe-module-faxsms that allows authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary files via the file_path parameter. Attackers can use action=download to read credentials and source code, or action=setup with base64 content to write web-executable files for code execution.

SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DocumentType constructor that injects header textContent into innerHTML without HTML escaping. Attackers can store entity-encoded HTML in h1-h6 headers that executes JavaScript when editors using document:header mode initialize, enabling session cookie theft.

SunEditor before 3.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the html.clean() sanitizer's _normalizeURL() function decodes named entities like : to an empty string. Attackers can inject href values such as javascript: that pass the _isSafeURL() check but are decoded by browsers, executing JavaScript when victims click stored links.

JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl leak the decoded key of an object rejected for a missing colon in decode_hv. Unless it is short plain ASCII, a quoted key is decoded into a new scalar. Nothing frees that scalar when the object is rejected for a missing ':' after the key. A process that keeps running after a failed decode retains one key per rejected document, with its size chosen by the sender. Repeated requests exhaust process memory.

A vulnerability was found in Chengdu Feiyuxing Technology VW2100 and VEC10GP 1.0 B-MB3W202-210825-r11775. GV-Face transmits sensitive user credentials and related authentication data over unencrypted HTTP connections. The HTTP traffic is not encrypted, an attacker with the ability to intercept network traffic.

ai.action: Apply any vendor update that enforces HTTPS, and in the meantime isolate GV-Face traffic on trusted network segments or protect it with a VPN/TLS.

The Woocommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin through 1.1.0 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks in one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to overwrite any site option with the URL of an uploaded image or an empty value, breaking the site (for example by changing its URL or active , or deactivating every Woocommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin through 1.1.0).

Authorization bypass in the creation of projects in XOneManager 3.8.3.0. The server processes POST requests to ‘/xmanagercore/api/Project/ConvertBDToProject/’ without verifying the administrative role. An authenticated user with basic privileges can create a project and execute SQL queries on the linked database from that project.

Authorization bypass via a user-controlled key in XOneManager 3.8.3.0. The 'ConvertBDToProject' operation selects the database based on 'databasename' without verifying the user’s permissions on it. An authenticated user can link a project to a database outside their scope and identify existing databases based on API responses.

Authorization bypass in the ‘tablesData’ operation of the POST request to ‘/xmanagercore/api/services/’ in XOneManager 3.8.3.0. An authenticated project member can execute SQL queries using ‘filter’ without the server verifying their execution permissions. The queries use the service account’s permissions. During testing, databases outside the project were queried, including the authentication database.

Authorization bypass in the publication of XOneManager 3.8.3.0 updates. During testing, the server accepted initial requests from an authenticated project member with read-only access without verifying publication permissions. If the workflow is completed, updates with modified content could be distributed to managed devices.

The Ultimate Addons for Elementor Forms WordPress plugin before 1.0.8 does not properly validate the extension of uploaded files in its bundled file upload field, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files such as PHP scripts and achieve remote code execution.

title: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
desc: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

Kubero 3.0.0 through 3.1.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to forge administrative JWTs by using a hardcoded fallback signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset. Attackers can sign tokens with arbitrary role, userGroups and permissions claims, which JwtStrategy.validate() trusts without a database lookup, to take control of pipelines, applications, users and API tokens.

INDOTALENT WHMS (Asp.Net-Core-Inventory-Order-Management-System) before 10.20261109 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a hard-coded JWT signing key, issuer and audience in appsettings.json. Unauthenticated remote attackers can forge tokens for any user ID and role that the Tokens/DI.cs validator trusts, gaining administrator access to the entire API.

INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 contains a default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access because UserAdminSeeder creates admin@root.com with password 123456. Attackers can log in with these credentials, which carry every admin role and no forced password change, to fully control deployments that kept them.

Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via exponent-notation string in INTEGER encoding. The encoder routes any value with abs >= 2**31 to i2osp without validating that it is an integer. A string in exponent notation such as "1e8000" passes that threshold. Math::BigInt expands it to an 8001-digit integer, and i2osp's per-octet conversion loop is quadratic in that size. An attacker who controls encoded INTEGER values can exhaust CPU with a short exponent-notation string.

C-Kermit before 11.1.515 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote clients to execute shell commands by supplying unquoted arguments to REMOTE WHO or REMOTE SPACE. Attackers can append shell metacharacters to arguments passed through WHOCMD or SPACM2 to syscmd(), executing commands on the server host even when DISABLE HOST is set.

C-Kermit 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows Kermit clients to run shell commands on servers with host commands disabled by abusing REMOTE QUERY evaluation. Attackers can send a REMOTE QUERY invoking the command function, or define a macro via REMOTE ASSIGN and call execute to reach RUN, bypassing the nopush restriction and DISABLE HOST.

C-Kermit before 11.1.515 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in putsrv() in ckcfns.c that allows malicious peers to write past the srvcmd buffer by sending crafted packets. Attackers can use Kermit repeat-count compression in server command, GET, or file-header packets to write attacker-chosen bytes beyond the heap buffer on servers or receiving instances.

Attackers can request a code for a known email and submit unlimited guesses during its 300-second lifetime to set a chosen password and take over the account.

The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.

The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.

SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually in progress. ESCvar.data, which the handler writes through, is NULL until a segmented transfer is started. A master can send a DOWNLOADSEGREQ at any time and write through a NULL or stale pointer.

The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.

The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite. The length is checked against the remaining file capacity but not against the physical mailbox buffer size. A master can declare a large length while sending a short frame, causing FOE_fwrite to read past the end of the mailbox buffer.

The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO. sizeOfPDO summed them without checking the total against the size of the rxpdo[] or txpdo[] process data buffers. React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. In versions prior to 19.0.9, 19.1.10, 19.2.9 and 19.3.1, react-server-dom-webpack, react-server-dom-parcel, and react-server-dom-turbopack are vulnerable to denial of service. If an application supplies input containing relative path sequences (e.g., ../) to an SDK method, standard URL normalization may direct the outbound request to an alternative Okta Management API endpoint.

In the Okta .NET SDK Abstractions library, outbound HTTP requests are not restricted to the configured Okta organization domain when processing certain URL formats. AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver that allows remote attackers to log in to passwordless accounts without the configured defaultPasswordHash password. Attackers who know the name of a ClickHouse no_password account can submit any non-empty password, because connect() skips openPasswordless(), and obtain a session with that account's rights.

phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in multisite deployments that allows attackers to overwrite passkeys of accounts on other tenants via a shared PHP session store. Attackers can run WebAuthn prepare() for a login on one tenant, then replay the session against /api/webauthn/register on another tenant or the master to replace that user's passkeys and log in as admin.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability because the web installer ignores the legacy config/database.php during 3.x upgrades. Unauthenticated attackers can reinstall the site against an attacker-controlled database and create their own administrator account to take over the application.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the sqlsrv-based MS SQL driver that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in by submitting an empty username. Attackers can supply any non-empty password, triggering Windows integrated authentication that grants a full session with the web server identity's SQL Server privileges.

Flop.Cursor.decode/2 in lib/flop/cursor.ex decodes the after and before parameters with :erlang.binary_to_term/2 in :safe mode. In Eclipse versions 1.5-1.6.13, 2.0.0-2.0.22 and 2.1.0-2.1.2, the client library libmosquitto does not reject Will messages with payloads greater than 65535 bytes when calling `mosquitto_will_set()` or `mosquitto_will_set_v5()`. This results in up to 65535 bytes of uninitialised heap memory being transmitted as the Will. This can be mitigated by only passing payloads with a maximum length of 65535 bytes.

A hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability exists in affected Ethernet swiches. The use of a shared cryptographic key with insufficient key strength could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker, under certain conditions, to impersonate affected devices and potentially compromise the confidentiality and integrity of communications.

An improper firmware authenticity verification vulnerability exists in the affected Ethernet Switches products. An authenticated remote attacker with administrative privileges could exploit the lack of cryptographic signature verification to install unauthorized firmware, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution on the affected device.

desc: OpenFunction through 1.2.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace tenants to create privileged host-access pods by supplying unrestricted PodSpec templates in Function and Serving resources. Attackers with only Function or Serving create permissions can set privileged, hostNetwork, hostPID, or hostPath fields to mount the worker node's root filesystem and escalate to node access.
